files.summary: Read the complete documentation-only package initializer; it contains no definitions, wildcard imports, resource creation or compatibility export layer.

Reviewed both real stateful/runtime classes and every method; corrected the framework description parameter, removed an unused alternate schema formatter and preserved async response/collector protocols.

definitions.name: BaseAgent
definitions.declared_role: 所有智能体的基类，提供共享功能
notes: CLS-001/FUN-005: RoutedAgent base owns actual model/dialect/display-name/schema state and shared response/memory adapters used by seven concrete registered agents.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.__init__
definitions.declared_role: 初始化基础智能体
notes: NAM-001/CLS-002: The former agent_id value is actually AutoGen's description; renamed it to description and passed it by that keyword, preserving all existing string values and runtime-assigned identities.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.final_text
definitions.declared_role: SQL/prompts require a final text message, not a tool or runtime event.
notes: FUN-001/CLS-004: Private-to-capability static SDK-result adapter requires a final TextMessage with nonempty content; tool/runtime events cannot silently become SQL or explanation text.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.send_response
definitions.declared_role: 发送响应消息到流输出主题
notes: FUN-005: Async runtime publication preserves ResponseMessage source/content/final/result fields and the current stream topic/source identity.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.send_error
definitions.declared_role: 发送错误消息
notes: FUN-005: Shared async failure action logs the concrete agent error and publishes an explicit final error response.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.handle_exception
definitions.declared_role: 处理异常并发送错误消息
notes: ERR-003/FUN-005: Preserves the original exception traceback in logging and emits the existing error message through the actual response protocol.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.format_schema_context
definitions.declared_role: 将表结构信息格式化为SQL DDL字符串
notes: CLS-004/FUN-001: Actual query-analysis/explanation callers use this DDL-style schema representation; it retains the supported empty-schema mode and required populated metadata fields.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.rebuild_memory_from_content
definitions.declared_role: 从序列化的内容重建ListMemory对象
notes: FUN-005: Reconstructs actual AutoGen ListMemory/MemoryContent values from the serialized analysis history used by both SQL generators; optional metadata remains explicitly optional.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.serialize_memory_content
definitions.declared_role: 将ListMemory序列化为可传输的格式
notes: FUN-005: Serializes the actual ListMemory contents and MIME/metadata fields consumed by the downstream generator's inverse adapter.

definitions.name: StreamResponseCollector
definitions.declared_role: 流式响应收集器，用于收集智能体产生的流式输出
notes: CLS-001/FUN-005: Owns async UI callbacks, optional feedback callback and per-source buffers/timestamps; the class has real mutable stream state.

definitions.name: StreamResponseCollector.__init__
definitions.declared_role: 初始化流式响应收集器
notes: CLS-002: Creates independent callback/buffer/timestamp state; the optional callback is later required by the runtime registration boundary.

definitions.name: StreamResponseCollector.set_callback
definitions.declared_role: 设置回调函数
notes: FUN-005: Installs the concrete async ClosureAgent response callback without changing the framework's context/message argument protocol.

definitions.name: StreamResponseCollector.set_user_input
definitions.declared_role: 设置用户输入函数
notes: FUN-005: Installs the concrete optional interactive UserProxyAgent input callback used only when user feedback is enabled.

definitions.name: StreamResponseCollector.buffer_message
definitions.declared_role: 缓冲消息并在达到一定条件时发送
notes: FUN-001/ASY-001: Buffers source-specific text, detaches prior buffered content before callback awaits, flushes final/result-bearing messages and awaits each actual callback.

definitions.name: StreamResponseCollector.flush_all_buffers
definitions.declared_role: 刷新所有消息缓冲区
notes: ASY-001/FUN-005: Detaches current buffers before asynchronous delivery, preserving messages added by callbacks during a flush and the existing explicit no-callback mode.

changes: Renamed BaseAgent constructor agent_id parameter to description and updated all seven concrete subclasses; actual framework descriptions are unchanged.
Removed unused format_schema_as_markdown after checking source, tests, examples, scripts and docs; DDL and service prompt formatting remain at their actual callers.

files.summary: Reviewed the detached connection value object, supported provider assembly and query resource owner; no connection lifecycle or public serialization fields were changed.

definitions.name: ConnectionSettings
definitions.declared_role: Plain connection values that can safely leave an ORM Session's thread.
notes: CLS-005/ASY-007: Frozen plain-value dataclass is the actual boundary for moving connection configuration out of an ORM Session's worker thread; it preserves all existing fields.

definitions.name: ConnectionSettings.from_connection
notes: CLS-004: Classmethod copies explicit DBConnection fields while the caller still owns the ORM Session, and constructs via cls without dynamic attribute fallbacks.

definitions.name: _build_db_access
notes: CLS-002/RES-001: Creates a fresh DBAccess and connects only the actual mysql/postgres/postgresql service branches; unsupported Snowflake/other types fail explicitly instead of inventing adapters.

definitions.name: execute_query
definitions.declared_role: Execute ``sql`` against the provided ``connection`` and return dictionaries.
notes: RES-001: Owns the freshly connected DBAccess through full dataframe conversion and always closes it in finally; its service caller validates generated SQL before execution.

limitations: Actual service connection names are mysql, postgres and postgresql (case-insensitive). General DBAccess adapters for other engines are not advertised as supported by this service.

files.summary: Reviewed all domain constants, date/value objects and normalization/override functions; implemented the already documented current-quarter window and corrected an unsupported example.

definitions.name: TimeWindow
notes: CLS-005: Internal dataclass represents concrete date bounds and the parsed source phrase; it is shared with actual policy-domain and Text2SQL prompt callers.

definitions.name: _add_months
notes: FUN-001: Pure month arithmetic clamps the day to the real target month and correctly handles zero/negative month offsets without fallback dates.

definitions.name: parse_time_window
definitions.declared_role: Parse Chinese time phrases to a [start, end] window.
notes: FUN-001: Parses the declared numeric relative and calendar windows, preserving zero offsets and last-month end dates; now implements the already documented 本季度 branch with its actual quarter start.

definitions.name: infer_intent
notes: FUN-001: Returns actual count/sum/average/time-order/top-limit hints from the required query and preserves explicit top-N text rather than adding an inference framework.

definitions.name: normalize_terms
definitions.declared_role: Normalize common NL synonyms to their canonical values in-place within the NL query.
notes: FUN-001: Applies concrete region aliases and returns both the normalized text and actual applied replacements for downstream context.

definitions.name: candidate_tables_from_query
definitions.declared_role: Return a flat list of candidate table names hinted by NL keywords.
notes: FUN-001: Matches the real domain table hints, de-duplicates names while retaining first occurrence and does not fabricate unavailable table metadata.

definitions.name: domain_value_mappings_for_schema
definitions.declared_role: Build additional value-mappings based on generic synonyms and the actual columns in schema_context.
notes: FUN-001: Adds generic synonyms only for columns actually present in the supplied schema and merges explicit fully qualified overrides.

definitions.name: _apply_overrides
notes: FUN-001: Applies the existing configured region/table/column override schema to its actual owning maps, preserving fully qualified versus generic column semantics.

definitions.name: load_overrides
notes: RES-001/ERR-004: Optional override-file mode reads through Path resource ownership and logs individual file failures under the existing best-effort configuration contract.

changes: Implemented the documented 本季度 date-window mode using the current quarter's first month/day.
Corrected the module example 近三个月 to the actual supported numeric syntax 近3个月; no new Chinese numeral parser was introduced.
limitations: Optional override loading retains its existing logged best-effort behavior; no external configuration/schema migration was performed.

definitions.name: TableRanking
notes: CLS-005: Strict root model expresses the actual model-returned list of RankedTable objects rather than probing arbitrary output shapes.

definitions.name: _LRUCache

definitions.name: _LRUCache.__init__

definitions.name: _LRUCache.get
notes: FUN-005: Preserves the mapping-style get contract while moving hits to the recency end; a cache miss returns the explicit supplied default.

definitions.name: _LRUCache.put
notes: FUN-001: Implements the actual disabled/update/least-recent eviction behavior and keeps the configured memory bound.

definitions.declared_role: 创建回退分析结果
notes: FUN-001: Builds the complete supported keyword-only analysis shape from the actual query and extracted keywords, keeping failure fallback distinct from unknown/unvalidated model fields.

notes: FUN-001: Extracts concrete non-stopword text tokens for the existing matching fallback; no extra NLP dependency or parser framework is needed.

notes: FUN-001: Validates model ranking IDs against the actual available tables, applies real domain boosts and now sorts descending by final score before the later max-table cap.

definitions.name: find_relevant_tables_semantic.<lambda>@227:44
notes: FUN-005: New local sorted key selects the actual boosted tuple score; this ensures high-ranked domain candidates are not appended after lower-scored model entries.

definitions.name: basic_table_matching

notes: FUN-001: Existing fallback combines actual domain/table-name/description keywords and returns bounded descending relevance scores.

definitions.name: basic_table_matching.<lambda>@262:39
notes: FUN-005: Local sorted callback selects the concrete keyword matching score from each (table_id,score) pair.

definitions.name: format_schema_for_prompt

notes: FUN-001: Formats the actual selected table/column/relationship snapshot for the service prompt; its comment-style representation has actual callers distinct from the runtime's DDL-style formatter.

definitions.name: get_value_mappings
definitions.declared_role: 获取表结构上下文中列的值映射
notes: FUN-001/RES-001: Reads actual selected-column mappings inside the caller-owned Session and preserves explicit persisted values over domain synonyms; detached plain dictionaries leave the worker.

definitions.name: process_sql_with_value_mappings
definitions.declared_role: 替换自然语言术语，并只为 MySQL 修正支持的 text 类型转换。
notes: FUN-003/NAM-001: Uses literal escaped schema/value terms, preserves the established MySQL default and now accepts the actual db_type keyword so PostgreSQL casts are not rewritten into another engine's syntax.

definitions.name: process_sql_with_value_mappings.replace_value
notes: FUN-005: Regex callback binds the current replacement value in its default argument, escapes SQL quotes and preserves the existing LIKE wildcard mapping; it avoids numeric regex backreference corruption.

definitions.name: process_sql_with_value_mappings.replace_text_cast
notes: NAM-001/FUN-005: Renamed _replace_metadata_cast to match its actual generic qualified-column text-cast use; it emits the existing CAST(... AS CHAR) only in the MySQL branch.

definitions.name: validate_sql
definitions.declared_role: 检查单条 SELECT 查询边界；具体语法由数据库验证。
notes: FUN-001: Conservative policy now requires exactly one parsed SELECT and rejects INTO in addition to existing dangerous keywords/semicolon/optional-UNION checks; only SQLParseError is a normal validation failure and unexpected programming faults propagate.

definitions.name: extract_sql_from_llm_response
definitions.declared_role: 从LLM响应中提取SQL查询
notes: FUN-001: Extracts an actual SQL/code block or SELECT text without globally removing literal backticks; execution callers still validate the extracted candidate before driver access.

definitions.name: snapshot_schema
definitions.declared_role: Read metadata into plain values while the caller owns the Session.
notes: RES-001/FUN-001: Reads the connection-scoped metadata into plain values while its caller owns the ORM Session; relationships are kept only when both endpoint tables/columns belong to that snapshot.

definitions.name: select_relevant_schema
definitions.declared_role: Rank an already detached metadata snapshot on the model client's loop.
notes: ASY-001/FUN-001: Ranks an already detached snapshot on the model loop, applies the real positive configured table cap and filters columns/relationships to selected identities.

changes: Sorts semantic rankings after domain boosting before callers apply the max-table limit.
process_sql_with_value_mappings has explicit db_type keyword with the real existing MySQL default; other engines retain native ::text syntax.
